latest_release.name: v0.10.0
latest_release.body:
This is a substantial release, and it marks Handy being roughly feature complete as we move towards V1.

In this release, there are some big features like transcribing audio files, auto language detection for all of the transcription models we support, a brand new onboarding flow, and starting to redesign some of the UI. There are a ton more quality of life improvements and small little details that hopefully you'll enjoy as well.

The coming releases will be addressing issues and stability. From here on out, you shouldn't expect too many new features from Handy, but you should expect the app to become more beautiful and stable.

Given there's a lot of new features, likely there will be some new issues, and we will address those in the rest of this release, and it will wrap us up and bring us to V1. A massive, massive thank you to all the contributors, for this release. A ton of PRs have came in, and really appreciate people submitting fixes and continuing to help the app improve.

## What's Changed
* Use Handy icon for Windows NSIS installer by @MikaKrul in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2117
* fix: refresh custom sounds when opening sound selector by @MikaKrul in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/1941
* transcribe 0.3.0 by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2203
* Docs/ubuntu 26 04 gnome wayland troubleshooting by @henderson-01 in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2206
* docs: add overlay, wl-clipboard and non-QWERTY paste notes to the Ubuntu notes by @B-Galati in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2212
* fix(portable): retain access to legacy model cache by @leongrphc in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2116
* isolate transcribe.cpp backend in own worker by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2208
* fix: show that the model is loading instead of a stuck "Transcribing..." by @maurild14 in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2227
* docs: keep translation contribution guidance aligned with supported locales by @johnjheejin in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2235
* fix(linux): allow renderer opt-out without dropping crash protection by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2249
* transcribe 0.4.0 by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2265
* move to handy-recorder by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2188
* transcribe.cpp vad by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2267
* feat: support Anthropic Messages API format in the Custom post-processing provider by @diligentpig in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2257
* fix: avoid duplicate history rows during live updates by @johnjheejin in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2256
* fix: expose setting names to screen readers by @johnjheejin in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2238
* add ui to migrate onnx model users to gguf by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2277
* actually remove onnx by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2279
* feat: pass custom words via transcribe-cpp vocabulary API by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2284
* long form chunking with vad by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2282
* catalog from @handy-computer/models package by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2299
* fix: stop blocking the main thread during paste by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2302
* fix: center grade chip labels on Windows by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2326
* feat: transcribe files into history by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2315
* add language detection by @cjpais in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2331
* fix: declare OpenSSL 3 runtime dependency in Debian packages by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2336
* fix: reuse one HTTP client for post-processing requests by @rnmrnmrnmrnmrnmrnm in https://github.com/cjpais/Handy/pull/2344
